name: Camp Sangamon For Boys
description_short: Boys' summer camp for ages 9-16 on a lake in central Vermont, near Rutland and Killington. Campers can book two-, three-, four- or five-week sessions, and activities include outdoor pursuits, aquatics, farming, creative arts and sports.
refund_policy_summary: For 2027: if camp can't safely open, all deposits and tuition are fully refunded. If your family withdraws after March 15 and before May 1, everything paid beyond the deposit is returned. Cancellations after May 1 get no refund. Deposit is $350 with the application, or $500 for early enrollment by December 31. Early enrollment gets 3% off, with the balance due March 1. Regular enrollment: half the balance is due June 1 and the rest on arrival. Siblings get 3% off each child's tuition.
